craft_notes: Sthāyin: lament-joy (the fool's voice quoted). Close: error (holds). Rejected: softening the fool — killed: unwise kept; dropping the quote — killed: 'I am utterly lost' carried.

lines: Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost outright here;
'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise maintain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kāryonmukhaḥ prayatno yaḥ kevalaṃ so 'tra lupyate | tasmin lupte vilupto 'smīty abudhaḥ pratipadyate

reads_against.argmap: Mere effort facing effect is lost here; when lost, 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.
c1_essence: Mere facing-effect effort lost; 'utterly lost am I' holds the unwise.
